office_does: The sheriff runs the Spokane County Sheriff's Office, the county's chief law-enforcement agency, which patrols unincorporated areas, makes arrests and serves court orders and warrants.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent John F. Nowels (Prefers Republican Party), sheriff since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Spokane County Sheriff since 2023 after 28+ years in the Sheriff's Office; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Sheriff since 2023; 28+ years in the office, including undersheriff and drug task force commander [S1]
Cites ending a 40+ vacancy rate and launching a Real Time Crime Center [S1]
Joined three other Eastern Washington sheriffs in a 2026 lawsuit against a state law letting decertification remove sheriffs [S2]
